metrics.profile_summary: Aspiring Digital Marketer with an MBA in Marketing and a BBA. Experienced in social media management, content creation, and customer relations, with a focus on driving user engagement and business growth.

education.degree: Master of Business Administration in Marketing

experience.description: Managed Facebook and Instagram accounts to enhance customer satisfaction and deliver excellent service.
Collaborated with clients to understand needs and provide tailored solutions.

strengths: Practical experience with Facebook and Instagram
Content creation and basic design skills
weaknesses: Lacks documented experience with UTM tracking and reporting
No mentioned experience with TikTok or competitor research
Professional experience is more customer-service focused than marketing-strategic
evaluation.summary: The candidate meets the educational requirements and possesses the basic social media skills needed. However, they lack the specific technical experience in campaign analytics and reporting required for a full Marketing Specialist role.
